text_block_list.text:
Caught up preparing for an upcoming
networking
event outside the academy,
many students are
returning later than
usual.
Sniffle, sob... I'm so, so scared...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Eek! N-no, no! Please don't eat me! I
don't tast—
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: W-wait... You're not a ghost...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry for yelling! Time just got
away from
me while I was doing event
prЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
I found myself alone in the dark and
scared... I
couldn't move! But I'm so glad
I'm not alone...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: WHOOOOO'S THERE?!
Eeeeek! Wh-what now?!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Hehehe. No one's here.
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Buuut! That's a win for me!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: T-Turbo? What do you mean by "win"?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
So you were preparing for the event and
fell
asleЭпизод..
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
B-but then you heard footsteps behind
you and
ran away as fast as you could?!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Yup! I turbo-boosted right outta there!
And since
I don't hear any ghostly
footsteps anymore, that
means I win!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
B-but... in movies, sometimes people
think
they've gotten away when they
really haven't...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
No one can keep up with me! No
slowpoke ghost's
gonna catch me like a
deer in some red tights!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
I think she means "deer in the
headlights"...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
B-but still, walking around in the dark
sure is
scary...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Really? You're scared, Rice? Then I'll go
home
with ya!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: But you'll hafta keep up with me and my turbo boost!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр
choice_data_list: You'll be home in no time if you both run.

There might be a ghost waiting to get the jump
on you.

text_block_list.text:
I see... Y-yeah, you're right. The faster
we leave
school, the safer I'll feel!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Youuu betcha! I'm a genius! Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Hey, can you give us a starting signal?
The shoe
cabinet's the finishing line!
We'll sprint to that!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
WOOO! Bahahaha! This is awesome! I
can hear
our footsteps echoing around!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! And your laughter is echoing too,
Turbo!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
BAHAHAHA! You're right! You should
try
laughing real loud too, Rice!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Th-the two of us? I suppose that would be less scary, but...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
You'll be cursed with bad luck if you go
with me...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: ...EEEEEK?!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: GAHHHHH?! What?! What is it?!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: I-I saw a figure in the window just now!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр
choice_data_list: Are you sure it wasn't your own shadow?

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... right... Aw, I'm sorry!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Nope! I'm pretty sure it's a ghost! We
gotta get
outta here before it catches
us!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-wait, Turbo! It really was just my
shadow!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Slip! THUD!

GRAAAAAH! What's a banana peel
doing lying
around here?!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Oh noooo! I'm so sorry, Turbo! You're getting hit with bad luck because you're with me!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Wha?! Now that's just a mean ghost!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
I explain to them that it's best for
everyone to
stick together instead of
running around in the
dark.

Right, I think it's riskier to run... And it
shouldn't
be scary if we're all together...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Hmm... Really? No running?
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
...Okay! Then I'll go ahead and make
sure
nothing's waiting to ambush us!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Oh, Turbo!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: ...Wow, I'm so glad she's here.
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Wait, no. I'm the older one here! I need
to step
up!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Heeey! The coast's clear! No ghosts!
Hurry up!
C'moooon, let's goooo!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
I leave the school building with Twin
Turbo
running around, full of energy,
and Райс Шоуэр
smiling softly.

Mayhem gives rise to more mayhem as
the two
run off in a fluster.

The footsteps and cheery voices of the
two
Umamusume echo throughout the
quiet school
building.
